answer: Each new identity needs one sponsor who locks a 120-credit bond in the oasis pool. That bond is listed in the public atlas and splits equally, so coverage is 120/k. Admission needs 40 credits, so a sponsor admits at most three; a fourth drops all to 30 and all fail. Sub-threshold identities wait in the lagoon queue. Fraud burns the bond and suspends the sponsor. Pooled bonds count under one key, so sponsor farming fails. 1,000 fakes need 334 sponsors and 40,080 credits locked, no discount; an honest newcomer needs one sponsor and one refundable bond, coverage checkable in the atlas.
